author: robin-dev
title: Add fee rows to top-up export

linkedIssue.body: Top-up exports must include a separate fee row for every top-up that has a fee, so bookkeeping balances. Paginate exports with the existing cursor/limit input.

existingComments.author: cubic-dev-ai
existingComments.body: `toPagination` just copies its input; consider removing it.
